nodes.title: FastAPI · update endpoint
nodes.subtitle: Correct bucket + record change
nodes.description: Update the existing transaction and save its correction history together in PostgreSQL. Then index the correction for retrieval.

steps: Update existing report_bucket and insert correction history in one PostgreSQL commit
Embed the saved correction and upsert its vector record

nodes.note: Proposed endpoint. No new transaction is created. Before/after values are checked against the stored transaction; identity comes from the authenticated request. A missing reason remains null.
nodes.narration: Update the existing transaction and save its correction history together in PostgreSQL. Then index the correction for retrieval.

nodes.title: PostgreSQL
nodes.subtitle: Updated bucket + correction history
nodes.description: Correct the existing report bucket and retain who changed it, before/after values and reason in the same commit.

data.commit: Update and correction history succeed or roll back together

nodes.note: PostgreSQL is the durable source. Store pending indexing state with the correction so a failed vector write can be retried and memory rebuilt.
nodes.narration: Correct the existing report bucket and retain who changed it, before/after values and reason in the same commit.

nodes.title: Embed + store correction
nodes.subtitle: One correction = one record
nodes.description: Embed the saved correction and upsert one vector record using its correction ID.

data.on_failure: Leave indexing pending; retry same correction_id

nodes.note: No splitting. An embedding model is used; provider undecided. Retry pending corrections using the same ID, then mark indexed. A failed vector write does not erase the transaction correction. Indexing has its own worker trace linked to the original request by job_id, request_id and correction_id; do not assume automatic cross-process nesting.
nodes.narration: Embed the saved correction and upsert one vector record using its correction ID.

nodes.title: Private correction memory
nodes.subtitle: This user only
nodes.description: Keep the correction together for later retrieval.
nodes.note: Derived retrieval index; rebuild from PostgreSQL correction history. Exclude undone or superseded corrections. Owner isolation is enforced in retrieval; implementation remains outside this diagram.
nodes.narration: Keep the correction together for later retrieval.

nodes.title: Embed + store web context
nodes.subtitle: Save · embed · upsert
nodes.description: Save the accepted public fact durably, then embed and upsert it in shared vector memory.
nodes.narration: Save the accepted public fact durably, then embed and upsert it in shared vector memory.

data.on_failure: Keep pending indexing state; retry without duplicating the fact

nodes.input: Public output from Prepare additional context
nodes.note: Use the same indexing mechanism as corrections, with a separate public scope. Persist the local transaction-to-knowledge link privately. Failed shared indexing must not block current classification. Link this background job to the originating classification trace with safe IDs. Record pending age, attempts and final state separately from classification quality.

nodes.title: Shared web knowledge
nodes.subtitle: Public facts · reusable by everyone
nodes.description: Reuse sourced merchant facts from previous research across users.
nodes.narration: Reuse sourced merchant facts from previous research across users.
nodes.note: Logical collection in the vector database; not necessarily another database service. Revalidate expired facts; exclude stale or revoked records. Public merchant facts never override personal corrections or prove how a particular user pays.

nodes.title: Prepare additional context
nodes.subtitle: For Jev + shared memory
nodes.description: Receive the web finding, check relevance and merchant identity, then prepare two outputs: transaction-linked context for Jev and public knowledge for embedding.
nodes.output: Context for Jev + public embedding payload
nodes.note: One function fans out to both consumers. Share only supported public facts; keep transaction links private. Reject ambiguous or irrelevant facts from shared storage. A failed embedding write must not block the context sent to Jev.
nodes.narration: Prepare context for Jev and send the public portion for embedding.

nodes.title: LangSmith traces
nodes.subtitle: Request + linked indexing jobs
nodes.description: Observe the classification request and correlate its background indexing traces.
nodes.narration: Observe the classification request and correlate its background indexing traces.
nodes.note: Proposal extending the existing Jev trace. One root covers the request; workers use separate traces linked by trusted safe IDs or explicit context propagation. Sanitize all traced layers, metadata and errors. Traces explain execution, not correctness. Instrument every request exit, including first-pass results and failures. The correction API request is a separate root; link its worker to that request, with optional lineage to the earlier classification.

nodes.title: Monitor + flag runs
nodes.subtitle: Errors · latency · indexing lag
nodes.description: Observe operational health and score a sample of captured traces for possible quality problems.
nodes.narration: Observe operational health and score a sample of captured traces for possible quality problems.

online_checks: Approved-content applicability / judge checks when content is available
data.review_selection: Flag suspicious runs and review a random sample of ordinary successes
data.not_measured: Judge pass rate is not classification accuracy

nodes.note: Application metrics cover traffic not captured by tracing. Fully hidden content cannot support semantic online judging; use approved redacted content or structural checks. Keep evaluator cost/sampling and alert thresholds configurable.

nodes.title: Review the reference
nodes.subtitle: Confirm · sanitize · approve
nodes.description: Check the transaction and reason, establish the owner-specific reference, and approve a safe example.
nodes.narration: Check the transaction and reason, establish the owner-specific reference, and approve a safe example.
nodes.note: A user correction is not automatically universal ground truth. Confirm the appropriate reference and permission to retain the example. Rejected or unresolved cases are not promoted.

nodes.title: Reviewed regression set
nodes.subtitle: Case + reference + prior evidence
nodes.description: Keep reviewed failures as repeatable tests for the next pipeline change.
nodes.narration: Keep reviewed failures as repeatable tests for the next pipeline change.

data.holdout: Separate untouched evaluation set, not repeatedly tuned on

nodes.note: Keep reference labels distinct from retrieval memory. Do not insert the target answer into its own replay corpus. Separate development regression cases from the final holdout.

nodes.title: Frozen test world
nodes.subtitle: Dataset + memory + versions
nodes.description: Pin the inputs, references, prior memory, source fixtures and model configuration used by both compared versions.
nodes.narration: Pin the inputs, references, prior memory, source fixtures and model configuration used by both compared versions.
nodes.note: Declaring a snapshot in trace metadata does not enforce it. The evaluation target must actually retrieve from the frozen store and suppress live memory writes. Use earlier user memory for later-user personalization; test cold starts separately.

nodes.title: Compare pipeline versions
nodes.subtitle: Baseline ↔ candidate
nodes.description: Run baseline and candidate on the same frozen cases and check both quality and operational limits.
nodes.narration: Run baseline and candidate on the same frozen cases and check both quality and operational limits.

data.workflow: Original classification workflow, run in isolated evaluation mode
checks: Exact bucket correctness against reviewed references
Cross-owner exclusion and manual override preservation
data.comparison: Inspect improvements and regressions, not only aggregate score

nodes.note: Use code evaluators for exact buckets, reviewed rubrics for semantic checks. A no-memory baseline measures whether retrieval helps. Representative cases and uncertainty matter; synthetic examples are not production benchmarks.

nodes.title: Candidate decision
nodes.subtitle: Inspect regressions before rollout
nodes.description: Use the comparison report to revise the candidate or approve a controlled rollout under agreed gates.
nodes.narration: Use the comparison report to revise the candidate or approve a controlled rollout under agreed gates.

gates: No lost corrections or duplicate indexing records
Agreed quality and per-bucket regression limits
data.on_failure: Keep current version; revise candidate and replay the same frozen snapshot
data.on_pass: Human-approved controlled rollout; observe new runs and repeat the review loop

nodes.note: Proposed release policy, not an automatic deployment step. No single LangSmith score certifies production readiness.
